name: Fluspirilene
aliases: Imap, Fluspirileno, Fluspirilenum, Imap®, MCN-JR-6218, R-6218, Redeptin, Redeptin®
summary: Fluspirilene (Redeptin, Imap, R6218) is a diphenylbutylpiperidine typical antipsychotic drug, used for the treatment of schizophrenia. It is administered intramuscularly.
